bullets: GC reported no incidents. A crane was on site 09/10 for the CMU block delivery; the pre-lift meeting was held with no issues.
Toolbox talk covered silica dust ahead of the existing bay slab demolition.
OPM accepted the revised baseline schedule as of 09/14: steel delivery 10/19/2026 and substantial completion 03/15/2027 (Item 1.01 closed).
The C-line footing pour has moved to the week of 09/21 pending the RFI 007 response. GC stated the week is absorbed by float ahead of the 10/19 steel delivery and does not affect the completion date.

Existing bay slab demolition starts 09/21, immediately after Engine 2 is relocated. Because the crew quarters share a wall with the bay, OPM requested a two-week look-ahead with the demolition sequence and a dust control plan (poly and negative air at the shared wall); GC to submit by 09/18 (Item 3.02).
Change Order 01, carrying PCO 001 and PCO 002, was issued by OPM on 09/10.

PCO 004 (ledge removal) was submitted 09/14 at $17,860 with signed T&M tickets and trucking slips, within the $18,500 not-to-exceed. OPM and Architect will review and OPM will issue a recommendation to Owner by 09/22 (Item 2.02).
Owner's contingency after PCO 004 is approximately $131,000 remaining of $165,000; OPM to confirm the exact figure.

RFI 007 (footing elevation at gridline C) was due 09/11 and is past due. Architect reported the response is drafted and awaiting the structural engineer's stamp; to be issued to GC by 09/17 (Item 1.02).
RFI 008 (roof drain routing at the addition) was received 09/14; Architect will respond within ten days. Not critical.

Generator resubmittal No. 2 was returned 09/14 'Approved as Noted', with comments on the battery charger and remote annunciator location; GC will release the generator order this week (Item 2.03 closed).
GC expects ASI 03 pricing to be under $2,000 and will submit it next week.
Underground work is complete except the water service. Elevator shaft CMU is at the second lift. Hollow metal frames are on site.
Two-week look-ahead: C-line footings, third lift of CMU, existing bay slab demolition, and start of underslab electrical in the addition.

The DPW water tap (Item 1.05) remains unscheduled despite Owner's follow-up and is now holding underground backfill. OPM will call the DPW Director by 09/17 and copy the Town Administrator (Item 3.01).
The Building Inspector has been notified for the C-line footing inspection the week of 09/21.
The Fire Prevention Officer signed off on the sprinkler shop drawings last week.
Chief Benson selected Option B, harbor gray with safety yellow striping, for the apparatus bay (Item 1.06 closed). Physical samples were delivered 09/10 (Item 2.01 closed).
Engine 2 moves to Station 2 on 09/19 as planned (Item 2.04).
Day room furniture is carried in the FF&E allowance. Owner to confirm the allowance amount with the Town Accountant by 09/29 so furniture selections can begin with the Architect (Item 3.03).
The NorthStar Cx contract was executed 09/14 (Item 1.07 closed); R. Patel will attend OAC meetings going forward.
NorthStar will issue the commissioning plan and the list of submittals requiring Cx review by 10/02; the generator, switchgear and RTU submittals are the priority (Item 3.04).

decisions: Revised baseline schedule accepted by OPM as of 09/14/2026: steel delivery 10/19/2026, substantial completion 03/15/2027.
C-line footing pour moved to the week of 09/21/2026 pending the RFI 007 response.
